blocks.text: Our outside IT support will take the file server and the document management system offline tomorrow evening for updates and a backup test. The work begins after close of business and is expected to finish overnight. The docket system runs on the same server, so it will be unavailable as well. Email will stay up throughout.

Before you leave tomorrow, save and close your open documents, log out of the docket system, and print the reminders you will need for the rest of the week. I am the office contact for the work this week. If a filing has to go out during the window, tell me by noon tomorrow so the start can be moved.
